title: Keep-connection build 17 verified and ready to install
summary: Signed Android 1.0.15/build 17 preserves approved direct access when leaving the viewer and securely restores it when reopening. 20 focused JavaScript tests and 10 native tests pass; physical phone acceptance remains untested.

changes.detail: Android Back pauses the viewer instead of sending Stop to the shared phone.

Remember direct session credentials with expo-secure-store, bound to the exact Tailscale origin. Explicit disconnect and server rejection clear the saved credential; a new QR takes priority. Credentials never enter URLs or AsyncStorage.

Add Back / keep connection action and resumption guidance. Prepare Android version 1.0.15 build 17. Existing foreground sharing service remains independent of screen navigation with stopWithTask=false and a visible Stop sharing notification.
Update French, English and Arabic help to explain reopening without new pairing. Retain visible host Stop sharing and explicit viewer Disconnect.

Signed arm64 APK, installation/acceptance guide, and regression tests for Back, remount, module restart, exact-origin restoration, new QR priority, host rejection, queued deletion and late bridge messages.

validation.name: App checks
validation.detail: 20 focused JavaScript interaction/storage/history tests passed; TypeScript and focused ESLint passed. Follow-up translated help correction passed phone-page test and lint. npm.cmd/npx.cmd used after PowerShell blocked the .ps1 wrappers.

validation.name: Android build and native tests
validation.detail: 10 JVM server tests, zero failures/errors. Final Gradle release build succeeded in 1m 21s with 855 tasks; existing Gradle deprecation warnings remain.

validation.name: Packaged APK
validation.detail: Version 1.0.15/code 17, signature matches build 11, persistent viewer strings and report bundled, current viewer source matches staging, native QR/recovery features and viewer assets present, stopWithTask=false and no microphone permission. SHA256 27f9e7d946f2d2a49157ad97b8068fed0d1fa5fedc1290aa38de863103cb50b9. Packaged-string verification initially failed because the verification script encoded the middle dot incorrectly; corrected Unicode handling and the check passed.

validation.name: APK credential audit
validation.detail: All 1403 ZIP entries passed known private-value, common credential-pattern and private-file checks. This does not prove absence of unknown or encoded secrets.

validation.name: Physical acceptance and delivery
validation.detail: No ADB phones connected. Actual host Home/Back/Recents, viewer kill/relaunch, two-phone VPN recovery and overnight use remain untested. Android lock, force-stop, process death, reboot, capture revocation and current rotation handling can end host sharing. Legacy relay does not gain persistence. No deployment/OTA or device installation. The APK bundles the initial change report; this post-build verification report is in workspace history for a later build.
